name: Wave Cyber (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Shanghai, China, Wave Cyber (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a specialized firm dedicated to the manufacturing and distribution of essential components for environmental water treatment systems. The company's product line features items such as pressure tanks, membrane pressure vessels, brine tanks and cabinets, and reverse osmosis membranes. Established in 2001, it provides these crucial parts for water purification.
